title: Native cheat adapter registry and runtime-evidence gate

policy.rule: A catalog ID is runtime-connected only when a specific allow-listed handler, typed argument contract, runtime state read-back, save/reload test, and regression evidence all pass.

candidate_actions.label: Gold +100K

effect_candidate.semantics: fixed increment candidate; not a set-to-target slider

evidence.detail: onDebug numeric branch 6.0 is statically associated with RewardGold(100000.0).
Candidate button is serialized with action route uai_gp_hud.onDebug(6.0).
All 5,630 STK entries decode; only Resources/HUD/pause.hud differs.

required_gates: game starts on disposable test profile
candidate button is visible on the pause screen
tap reaches the intended onDebug branch
no unrelated progress or save mutation
Gold change survives a clean save/reload
original install and save recovery remain available
candidate_actions.explicit_limit: This candidate is not mapped to economy.currency_override because a fixed +100,000 reward cannot implement the catalog slider's set-to-target semantics.
